display_policy: At least ten distinct calibration districts for a 90th-percentile band: one expected tail case at best; not a coverage guarantee. Fixed from calibration tail resolution, not final errors.

interval_score.interpretation: Proper central-interval diagnostic of width and misses; reporting it does not establish calibration.

development.display_subset_note: Withholding does not recalibrate or widen any radius. Its coverage is a changed subset, not an improved accuracy claim.

final.display_subset_note: Withholding does not recalibrate or widen any radius. Its coverage is a changed subset, not an improved accuracy claim.

zero_history_diagnosis.reason: All final C cases are M+12; its radius comes from one calibration district/target. Other C horizons have 1-6 districts. This tiny, geographically different calibration panel is consistent with poor transfer and cannot support local probability claims; the audit does not establish a unique causal mechanism.
zero_history_diagnosis.corrective_action: Withhold unsupported numerical bands; keep all twelve labelled regional/global point references unchanged. Acquire new independent local evidence, not post-holdout band widening.

limitations: Dependent and overlapping historical cases; fractions are descriptive, not independent binomial coverage estimates.
Small state/horizon panels are reported with denominators and dates, never as district-specific calibrated probabilities.
No wider radius, new quantile, model, threshold or method was selected using final residuals.
The original previously inspected holdout cannot establish new prospective reliability.
